title: Home Oxygen Therapy Under a New Primary Coverage: First Day of Service and the New Payment Period
content:
# First Day of Service Under a New Primary Coverage — Home Oxygen Therapy

The first day of service a new primary coverage covers for Home Oxygen Therapy is its effective date on the coverage record, and a new payment period begins under it on that day, written as YYYY-MM-DD.

## Elements

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Record read | the coverage record of the new coverage, which is active and primary |
| Date read | its effective date |
| First day of service | the effective date |
| New payment period | begins on the same day |
| Format | YYYY-MM-DD |

## Worked example (hypothetical)

A patient's new coverage record shows an effective date of 1 July 2025.

1. The first day of service the new coverage covers is 1 July 2025.
2. The new payment period under that coverage begins on 1 July 2025, written 2025-07-01.

## Questions answered

**Which coverage record supplies the date?** The coverage that is now primary for the oxygen, by its effective date.

**Do the first day of service and the start of the new payment period differ?** No; the new payment period begins on the first day of service.
